comparison_curves.meaning: derived SI-metre curves retained so the public figure can be regenerated without the CoupFE NPZ or publisher pickle files

plumbing.ambit_first_timestamp_handling: hash-pinned 0.001 s first timestamp mapped by upstream sample index to the common 0.000 s grid
plumbing.meaning: hashes, restricted decoding, schemas, SI units, completion, and exact Step-2 Case-B physical identity passed

publisher_material_attribution.source_title: A software benchmark for cardiac elastodynamics
publisher_material_attribution.transformation_notice: CoupFE-Cardiac selected the ten hash-pinned Step 2 Case B publisher files, mapped the Ambit first sample to the publisher common grid by upstream sample index, and computed team mean, standard deviation, minimum/maximum envelope, selected Simula curves, event summaries, and comparison metrics. These are modified/derived data; raw publisher pickle files are not redistributed.

contraction_events.definition: linear-interpolated downward ux crossings during 0.16--0.32 s; publisher summaries are statistics of ten per-team crossing times

reproduction.meaning: these are numerical agreement diagnostics, not a plumbing pass

paper_relative_discrepancy.definition: mean over the 101 common-grid times of the pointwise vector-error norm divided by the all-team-mean displacement-vector norm

post_snap_branch.definition: settled post-snap branch and plateau metrics on 0.32--0.48 s; the 0.16--0.32 s transition is reported separately

relaxation_rebound.definition: centered rebound speed at 0.51 s is [ux(0.52)-ux(0.50)]/0.02; recovery is measured from the 0.40--0.50 s ux minimum toward zero
